description: Read the AUTHORITATIVE entity dossier (the HOT memory tier) for a named entity: a compiled summary, key facts (with confidence), origin files and a timeline. This is the highest-trust source — when a dossier exists it directly answers "who/what is X" and "where does X come from", with no hedging. Built on-the-fly if missing.

name.description: The entity name to fetch the dossier for (e.g. "Fabio", "Ground Control")

name: gctrl_get_dossier
